# Restorative Conversation Prep Sheet

Subject: SEL and Advisory
Grade band: 6-12
Resource type: Prep Sheet
NYS framework label: NYS SEL Benchmarks and local advisory goals

## Short Description
A reflective prep sheet for students preparing to repair harm and re-enter classroom routines.

## Alignment Note
Supports reflection, responsibility, relationship repair, and student-centered re-entry.

## Classroom Use Case
Use before a facilitated conversation with a teacher, counselor, or administrator.

## Preview Content
- What happened from my view
- Who was affected
- What I can do to repair and move forward

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
